text:
Alyssa (CS): FYI — AcmeCorp opened a ticket: their EOM invoice doesn't match the dashboard. Dashboard CSV shows 1,120,345 tokens and Pro tier, invoice charged 1,500,123 tokens and bumped them to Business for the month. Customer is asking for explanation and immediate correction. Invoice: INV-2026-0309-ACME, acct_9764. Screenshot: https://rwd.prod/s/abc123 :cry:
Miguel (Billing): Can you paste the invoice id + account id (got it) and attach the dashboard export CSV? Also did they report any API errors that day?
Alyssa (CS): Attached the CSV export from Console > Usage > Export (small sample):
```
date,account_id,route,model,tokens
2026-03-01,acct_9764,text.generate,gpt-neo-3.0,412345
2026-03-01,acct_9764,text.generate,gpt-neo-3.0,350000
2026-03-01,acct_9764,embeddings,embed-v1,357,
2026-03-01,acct_9764,chat.complete,chat-2,357643
total_tokens,1120345
```
Priya (Account): Customer also mentioned they saw a flurry of 429s around 2026-03-01T00:10-01:20Z and retried client-side. Might be related.
Miguel (Billing): That token delta (≈379,778 tokens) smells like a double-count. Two common causes: duplicate ingestion retries or pre-aggregation bug on the billing job. Can @Sanjay check ingestion/windowed dedupe for acct_9764 around 2026-03-01 00:00-02:00 UTC?
Sanjay (Infra): Looking into the ingestion logs now. Quick find: I see two deliveries with the same payload id prefix for acct_9764 at 2026-03-01T00:12:03Z and 2026-03-01T01:12:03Z. Example log snippet:
```
[2026-03-01T00:12:03Z] ingest-service INFO event_id=evt_9a7f2c7a-0001 account=acct_9764 tokens=412345 source=api
[2026-03-01T01:12:03Z] ingest-service INFO event_id=evt_9a7f2c7a-0001 account=acct_9764 tokens=412345 source=retry
```
Sanjay (Infra): That matches the customer's retry window. Looks like our retry dedupe didn't catch this because event_id is being truncated to 20 chars in the old batch codec used by the Mar 1 aggregation job. New codec preserves full id.
Alyssa (CS): Customer said they got 429s and client retried — that explains duplicates. The Console UI export shows deduped counts (we dedupe at query-time for dashboards), while the invoice pipeline used the older agg job that counted raw events.
Miguel (Billing): Confirming: billing aggregation for that run used the legacy codec (we rolled a fix on Mar 2). Result: raw_events were double-counted for some accounts, and the post-aggregation tiering logic triggered Business tier because billed_tokens > 1.4M threshold.
Priya (Account): Draft customer message: "Thanks — we found an ingestion duplication bug at month-end that caused inflated token counts for a subset of customers (including AcmeCorp). We're issuing a $285 credit to correct the overcharge and will adjust the invoice and tiering for March. You'll see the corrected invoice and credit in 24-48 hours. Apologies for the disruption." Thoughts? :pray:
Miguel (Billing): Finance approved the $285 credit for acct_9764. We also need to update their plan tier back to Pro for March and ensure prorated billing is corrected. I'll open an invoice adjustment (adj_INV-2026-0309-ACME) and queue the credit.
Sanjay (Infra): Filed INGEST-724 for codec truncation and backfill job to dedupe Mar 1 window for affected accounts. Backfill ETA: 24h. I'll attach affected account list when job is ready.
Alyssa (CS): Great — I'll update AcmeCorp with the draft above + timeline and link to the support ticket. Priya, can you send the message once Miguel confirms the invoice adjustment id?
BillingBot: invoice adj_INV-2026-0309-ACME created by Miguel at 2026-03-01T15:34Z. Status: pending_approval.
Miguel (Billing): Approving now. Once adj is posted we'll notify customer and close the loop.
Priya (Account): Message sent to customer with credit amount and timeline. Keeping them on a follow-up cadence.
Alyssa (CS): Thanks everyone. Will mark as high priority until invoice and backfill complete. :white_check_mark:
